ChangeImageSize.description_en: Intelligently resizes images and supports multiple methods such as automatic cropping and padding
ChangeImageSize.description_zh: 智能调节图像尺寸，支持自动裁剪、补全等多种方案

DetectImageElements.description_en: Identifies the elements in the input image, annotates their positions with bounding boxes, and classifies them into primitive data types such as person/object, modifier, and text
DetectImageElements.description_zh: 识别输入图中所包含的元素，用矩形框标注出其位置，并区分其对应的基本类型（人/物、修饰、文案）

ExtendImageStyle.description_en: Transfers the style of an input image based on a specified style image, transforming visual elements such as colors and brushstrokes
ExtendImageStyle.description_zh: 将输入图按照指定的风格图像进行风格的迁移，使得图像的色彩、笔触等视觉风格发生转化

MakeSuperResolutionImage.description_en: Upscales a small image by four times and infers details to prevent the resulting image from appearing blurry
MakeSuperResolutionImage.description_zh: 将小图放大四倍，基于推断出的细节使得结果图像不显得模糊

RecognizeImageColor.description_en: Analyzes the color information of an input image and returns the color values in RGB and HEX formats along with their corresponding proportions
RecognizeImageColor.description_zh: 对输入图的颜色信息进行分析，给出颜色值（RGB形式和HEX格式）与对应的占比信息

RecognizeImageStyle.description_en: Analyzes the style of an input image and returns possible style tags
RecognizeImageStyle.description_zh: 对输入图的风格类型进行分析，给出可能的风格标签

RecolorImage.description_en: Recolors an input image automatically or based on a specified color palette, while preventing abnormal color transfer in visual hotspot areas
RecolorImage.description_zh: 将输入图自动或根据指定色板进行色彩转换，同时保证视觉热点区域避免不正常拓色

SegmentBody.description_zh: 识别输入图像中的人体轮廓并与背景分离，返回分割后的前景人像图（4 通道）

SegmentImage.description_en: Segments the main subject in the input image and generates a transparent PNG image. Supports subjects such as humans, animals, and objects
SegmentImage.description_zh: 对输入图中主体进行通用分割，输出对应的png透明图，支持包括人体、动物、物品等
